alliance.label: Alliance
alliance.description: Mutual-defense pact that reduces war pressure and improves trade confidence.

trade.label: Trade Pact
trade.description: Economic treaty for safer trade routes, tariffs, and shared market access.

non_aggression.label: Non-Aggression Pact
non_aggression.description: Limited peace treaty that strongly reduces conflict escalation without requiring alliance duties.

tribute.label: Tribute Treaty
tribute.description: Asymmetric settlement where one side pays tribute to delay war or secure protection.

sanction.label: Sanction
sanction.description: Hostile diplomatic pressure that damages trade and increases escalation risk.
